Q5253.reason: A reversion is the leftover estate that stays with the transferor by operation of law when less than the whole estate is conveyed, and it is the only one of these interests outside the Rule Against Perpetuities.

Q5347.reason: The first 1–2 seconds of maximal force are powered by ATP already in the muscle, before phosphocreatine or glycolysis can regenerate it.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the Grand Chamber held that upholding state immunity was a proportionate limit on Article 6 access to court, so immunity prevailed and there was no breach.
